description: Declare diagram work before doing it, with a concise summary and optional scope (default canvas). Target existing node IDs or a canvas region where new boxes will appear. Returns workId; always finish that ID with finish_live_diagram_work when done. Only one work item may be active per session. Valid diagram updates renew its five-minute lease; expiry or disconnect interrupts it instead of claiming success.

scope.description: Canvas, 1–200 unique existing node IDs, or finite canvas coordinates for a planned region

sessionId.description: Live diagram or architecture review opened or resumed on this connection

summary.description: What diagram work you are about to perform; concise, honest, and specific

name: begin_live_diagram_work
